title: CSV export drops the last row when the file has exactly 1000 entries
body:
Steps to reproduce:

1. Create a project with exactly 1000 issues.
2. Click Export → CSV.
3. Open the downloaded file.

Expected: 1000 data rows plus a header.
Actual: 999 data rows plus a header. The final row is missing.

Works correctly at 999 and 1001 entries, so this looks like an off-by-one at the pagination boundary. Error-free in the console.

title: Dashboard initial render exceeds 3s budget on /projects/:id
body:
`/projects/:id` takes 4.2s to first contentful paint on a cold cache (Chrome, throttled Fast 3G). Our budget is 3s.

Profiling points at `src/pages/project/ProjectBoard.tsx`, which fetches all issues before rendering any. Suggested fix: paginate the initial fetch to the first 50 items.

Done when Lighthouse FCP for that route is under 3s on the same throttling profile, and the existing board tests still pass.
